title: Agent detail screen with ledger-gated panels

claims.text: AgentScreen.checkHead throws HeadRace when the call head differs from the acknowledged ledger head.
AgentScreen.bracket reads ledger_events with limit 1 and requires no resync before each fold.
AgentScreen.available gates mutations by tool descriptor shape, selected actor, owner binding and ledger head.
AgentScreen.beat executes run_beat with a volatile heartbeat draft and reloads the runs panel on success.
AgentScreen.collisions detects identity key collisions across agent, skill, seat, unit and run keys.

triggers: Data is stale. Ledger prefix changed

decision.rule: Change here when AgentScreen ledger bracketing, staleness handling, tool availability gating, heartbeat drafts or panel rendering needs to change.
decision.failure: A panel reads a stale prefix, a mutation is offered without actor or descriptor checks, or the runs panel fails to refresh after a heartbeat.

questions.q: Where does AgentScreen bracket each fold with ledger_events to detect a changed prefix?
Where should I change how AgentScreen gates mutation buttons by actor and tool descriptor?
Where can I debug a stale Agent detail after a ledger prefix change?
Where does the Agent screen record a run heartbeat draft?
